claims.text: The resort sits on 24 oceanfront acres.

findings.quote: Isla Bella Beach Resort boasts 24 beautiful oceanfront acres

claims.text: It is on Knights Key in Marathon, midway between Miami and Key West.

findings.quote:
It’s located on Knights Key in Marathon, midway between
Miami
and
Key West

claims.text: Rooms are decorated in a palette of blue and white, with modern furniture and contemporary art.

findings.quote: A crisp palette of blue and white that connects you to the sea, playful prints, modern furniture, contemporary art, and luxury bathrooms welcome every guest.

claims.text: Each room has floor-to-ceiling glass doors opening to a private terrace.

findings.quote: each room features floor-to-ceiling glass doors and roomy private terraces to take in ocean views

claims.text: Room types include double queen rooms, one-bedroom suites with sofa beds, two-bedroom guestrooms and select suites with kitchenettes.

findings.quote: Accommodation options include Double Queen rooms, one-bedroom suites with sofa beds, two-bedroom guestrooms and select suites with kitchenettes.

claims.text: Guests can choose from five oceanfront pools set among palm-lined sandy shores.

findings.quote: Take your pick from five oceanfront pools set among the palm-lined sandy shores of Isla Bella.

claims.text: The Spa at Isla Bella is a 4,000-square-foot space with a couples massage room and a steam room in each locker room.

findings.quote: A 4,000 sq ft calm, soothing sanctuary
Couples massage room
Steam Room in each locker room

claims.text: The spa's Wellness Lounge offers a 20-minute couple's foot massage and a 20-minute Detoxifying Foot Soak.

findings.quote: we’re introducing two new side-by-side offerings in our Wellness Lounge
Guests can enjoy a soothing 20-minute couple’s foot massage, or opt for a 20-minute Detoxifying Foot Soak

claims.text: Fishing charters depart from the resort's own marina.

findings.quote: From our marina, hop on a fishing charter with some of the region’s most skilled and well-known fishermen.

claims.text: Dive Isla Bella offers over 30 dive locations, with Sombrero Reef Sanctuary as its premier dive site.

findings.quote: We have over 30 different dive locations to choose from at Dive Isla Bella, with our premier dive site being Sombrero Reef Sanctuary.

claims.text: Guided clear kayak eco-tours explore mangroves, seagrass flats and Boot Key Harbor.

findings.quote: Take a guided Eco-Tour through the waters of Marathon on a CLEAR Kayak exploring mangroves, seagrass flats, and Boot Key Harbor

claims.text: Mahina is the resort's signature oceanfront restaurant, built around fresh seafood and seasonal ingredients.

findings.quote: Dine with a view at Mahina, Isla Bella’s signature oceanfront restaurant.
Mahina showcases fresh seafood, seasonal ingredients, coastal favorites, and thoughtfully crafted cocktails

claims.text: Every room and suite has an ocean view and a furnished private outdoor living area.

findings.quote: Every guestroom and suite at Isla Bella Beach Resort includes an ocean view and a furnished private outdoor living area

claims.text: Ground-floor veranda rooms open directly onto the beach, while balcony rooms on the second or third floor have a private terrace overlooking the ocean.

findings.quote: Veranda rooms are located on the ground floor and provide direct beachfront walkout access. Balcony rooms are located on the second or third floor and feature a furnished private terrace overlooking the ocean.

claims.text: Conde Nast Traveler describes whitewashed, Greek-inspired architecture with blue and white interiors.

findings.quote: The whitewashed, Greek-inspired architecture and the eye-catching blue and white interiors set a sophisticated tone at this family-friendly resort.

claims.text: From October through January the resort hosts holiday events for the whole family, from ice skating at the beach to circus shows.

findings.quote: special holiday happenings that will surprise and delight the entire family from October through January. From ice skating at the beach to circus shows

claims.text: Parking is not included in the resort fee and is charged daily for self-parking or valet.

findings.quote: Parking is not included in the resort fee and is an additional $25 per day for self-parking, or $50 daily for valet parking.

claims.text: A resort fee applies; it includes complimentary bicycle rental.

findings.quote: Stop by our Marketplace to arrange a complimentary bicycle rental, included in the resort fee.

claims.text: WhataHotel notes that the Keys location means a longer journey from the mainland.
